title: The Name Wall
text: A wall covered in names, thousands of them, crossed out one by one in red. These were the faceless, the old folk say, before. Before they forgot. Near the bottom, written fresh, uncrossed, in your own handwriting, is a Scion's name.

options.label: The named Scion crosses out their own name.

outcomes.text: The city takes them for one of its own, and lets you all pass. They feel it take them.
Their face goes numb for a day, and their mouth will not shape words.

options.label: Scrub the name off the wall.

outcomes.text: It comes back, fainter, as you watch.

options.label: The wisest reads the other names.

outcomes.text: Some you know, from the House's histories, and how they ended.
